result.title: On the VC Dimension of Autoregressive Linear Threshold Functions
result.summary: Linear threshold functions (LTFs) are a canonical class of Boolean predictors. In the autoregressive setting, the same LTF reads the most recent $d$ bits, generates the next bit, and returns the bit produced after $T$ steps. While the one-step class has VC dimension $d$, for general $T$ the counting upper bound is $O(d^2)$. We prove that the VC dimension is $Θ(d^2)$ for every $T\ge d^2$, resolving the quadratic gap for deterministic autoregressive LTFs. We then adapt the same technique to show an exponential separation between deterministic and stochastic autoregressive models: replacing the sign of LTFs by logistic sampling can increase the VC dimension of the final majority prediction class from quadratic to exponential in $d$.

AI.brief_summary: 论文分析确定性自回归线性阈值函数（反复读取最近 d 位并输出下一位）在 T 步后输出位的 VC 维，证明 T≥d² 时由计数上界 O(d²) 收紧为 Θ(d²)，并证明把符号换成 logistic 采样可使该 VC 维从二次提升到指数。
AI.relevance_reason: 其结果把「自回归迭代步数」与模型容量直接挂钩，可供核查 loop/AR 式 latent 推理中步数与表达能力的关系，以及随机采样是否以容量换取收益；但对象为布尔函数理论，与视觉证据筛选无直接联系。
